description.label: Description
description.value:
Should the knights of Bretonnia answer the call of battle, their preservation and empowerment shall be my duty, so they may ward away all that is foul and evil. To strike down the foes of this great land of Chivalry, my obligation to the Lady is realized.

Choose one Troth. Channelling, ingredients, and lore effects for @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-nom.nom-journals.JournalEntry.szhETavVooj84NXa.JournalEntryPage.n0mJrnlLoreGrail]{Lore of the Grail} use this Wind: Ghyran (Lore of Life). Changing Troth is not offered.
